messages:
elena: Heads-up — Q3 console observability scope: ACME and Volt want per-route cost breakdown, trace sampling hooks by route, and an error analytics panel. Need prioritization before roadmap sync. Who's owning acceptance criteria?
matt: I can draft acceptance for per-route cost. Question: do we mean token-cost or infra-cost? They asked token cost primarily.
zara: Token cost + hot-path attribution (latency slices) would be most useful for customers planning model mix.
raman: For trace hooks, we should avoid adding latency. Proposal: async sampling via agent + metric tags. Example config:
```
tracing:
  hooks:
    - name: route_sampling
      path: /api/llm/*
      rate: 0.05
      async: true
```

sre-oncall: +1 on async. Need an SLO-backstop: default sample floor 0.01 so we don't lose visibility during spikes.
jamie: Error analytics: customers want grouped root-causes (model, infra, bad prompt). Suggest panel with:
- error rate by route
- error rate by model + http status
- sample traces for top N routes
elena: Good. Now let's trade off scope: MVP (must have) vs Stretch. My rough split:
MVP:
- per-route token cost (rollup in console)
- error rate by route + model
- trace sampling hooks basic config (rate + path)
Stretch:
- hot-path latency breakdown
- cost attribution to model embeddings vs generation
- interactive trace explorer for sampled traces
matt: Time estimates? Per-route token cost: 2 wks infra + 1 wk UI. Tracing hooks: 1 wk runtime + 1 wk infra. Error analytics panel: 1 wk frontend.
raman: We can shave infra work by reusing existing metric pipeline if we accept 5m delays. That buys us 1wk.
elena: Customers: ACME needs MVP by mid-Q3, Volt is flexible. If we want ACME renewal, MVP must be prioritized.
zara: Suggest priority: 1) per-route token cost 2) error analytics 3) tracing hooks (basic) 4) hot-path latency 5) cost attribution
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for metrics-pipeline upgrade at 2026-07-08T02:00Z
jamie: Acceptance criteria draft (short):
- Per-route token cost: per-route view + exportable CSV, accuracy within 5% vs billing
- Error analytics: filter by route/model, show top 10 errors, link to sampled traces
- Tracing hooks: admin can add path and rate, default floor 0.01, sampling is async
elena: OK - owners: matt (cost), jamie (errors), raman (tracing infra), zara (priority tracking). I'll put this in the roadmap doc and ask PM leadership to bump ACME into committed list if we firm dates.
matt: I'll start a short spec PR today.
raman: I'll open infra tickets, pinging @eng-infra for capacity estimates.
elena: Thanks. We'll reconvene in 48h to lock dates. :metal:
